# Pets and Farm Update — map files for the build (Map chat, updated 1 Nov 2026)

Approved by Karolis in the Map chat ("all looks good in map", 31 Oct). Lesson flags added 1 Nov (Karolis OK'd the flag model, entry objects-lesson-flag).

## Files (book db collection `kits`; copies in project docs)
- `pfu-placements` — ready-to-build list (use this one). Project doc `claude/pfu-placements.json`.
- `pfu-scene` — the raw World Builder scene (book db collection `cmp_wb`: edits v98, roads v68, ground v21), for checking. Project doc `claude/pfu-scene.json`.
- Each kits doc has one field `text` = the file as a string (JSON.parse it).

## Units
- Game metres, city frame: x east (+), z south (+); the town centre crossing is (0,0); Friends Lane runs west from x -84; the farm is north-west (z negative).
- ry = rotation around the vertical axis in radians (Three.js `rotation.y`); a model's front is its +z before rotation.

## pfu-placements
- `plan`: every thing in the approved farm plan, at its final spot (Karolis's moves applied, his deletions removed). Fields: id, name, x, z, ry, s (scale), and one of:
  - `pu`: a Pet update model id (Model Library / Model Compare, e.g. `farm:barn`), built with its default options;
  - `animal` + `age`: farm animal (cow, sheep, pig, chicken, horse; baby or adult only — farm animals have no teen, Karolis 30 Oct). o39 is an adult horse (the plan view still draws it as a teen; build it as an adult);
  - `fn`: a game or plan builder by name (Tree, Oak, Pine, Fir, Birch, Snowy pine, Bush, Rock, Mountain, Windmill, Old combine, FARM arch, Object = small farm props).
  - The 12 `Object` entries o111–o122 are the jump-field jumps (Pet update model `course:<kind>`, option c = colour). In order o111…o122: kind x, v, o, s, x, v, x, o, s, v, x, s; colour cycles #5f7fd8, #ff6b6b, #ffd45c, #5fd4b0 (o111 blue, o112 red, o113 yellow, o114 green, o115 blue …). x = Crossed poles, v = Straight bar, o = Wide oxer, s = Little cross (ponies).
- `added`: things Karolis or the Map chat added: `model` is the World Builder catalogue key (`pu:<id>` = Pet update model, `n:` nature, `f:` farm builders, `a:` farm animals, `pet:`, `s:` street, `fu:` furniture); `o` = model options. Includes the vet clinic (`pu:vet:clinic`, x 14.2, z -77.2), Stan and Ieva (`pu:farm:coach` {v:'stan'} / {v:'ieva'}), the Pet Show stage, podium and judges, and the two lesson flags (`pu:course:flag` {c:'blue'} / {c:'red'}).
- `roads`: dirt roads and horse trails as centre lines (`pts` = x,z,x,z…), `width` in metres, `kind` road/path/trail. Ends are round, joins are smooth (Catmull-Rom). Inside `farmBox` [x1,z1,x2,z2] roads are drawn as patchy trodden farm ground, not a road.
- `ground`: painted ground blobs {k: mud | farm | sand, x, z, r; sm=1 smooth edge, sx = x stretch}; mud gets small puddles. The pig area is mud; the Pet Show lawn is one smooth sand oval.
- `townDeleted`: game town things to remove (game forest trees, a few town trees/bushes) by position (x,z) and name; match the nearest of that kind within 0.6 m.
- `townMoved`: game town things moved (from → to).
- `laneBorder`: Friends Lane hedges at 37.5 m off the lane road (entry map-lane-border has the exact code lines).
- `animals`: farm animals wander in groups of their own kind, about 8 m around their spot.
- `riders`: Cody and Hank (farm:cowboy {v:'cody'}, {v:'hank'}) and Rose (farm:cowgirl {v:'rose'}), each on a horse, ride the trail roads now and then.
- `people`: Ieva by the stable grooms and lends horses; Stan at the jump field gives the first lesson (Karolis picked both, 31 Oct).
- `lesson`: Stan's lesson course (below).
- `townCodeChanges`: game code changes the update must make (Friends Lane hedges, park slide, food truck turn, keep forest generation).

## Stan's lesson course (story entry story-ieva-stan, stage 6)
No log (Karolis, 31 Oct). Stan stands at the jump-field rail gate, (-167.2, -98).
- Blue flag `pu:course:flag` {c:'blue'}: (-174, -116), ry 0. Placed (added id aflagblue).
- Red flag `pu:course:flag` {c:'red'}: (-189, -114), ry 0. Placed (added id aflagred).
- Step 4 jump: o122, the Little cross (ponies) already on the field, at (-175.72, -94.42), ry 0.488.
- Route: get on by Stan → walk north to the blue flag (about 19 m) → trot west to the red flag (about 15 m) → ride south-east over o122 (about 24 m; meets the jump square-on, about 6° off) → stop by Stan (about 9 m).
- Both flags are at least 6.6 m from every jump; every leg passes at least 4.1 m from the other jumps (closest: o112).
